arrive.text: The ship of Theseus. Its wood is getting old.

planks.text: New planks are stacked on the dock.

first.text: One new plank. Still the same ship, surely.

half.text: Half of it is new now.

all.text: Not one original plank is left. Is it still the same ship?

twist.text: Someone has kept every old plank.

rebuilt.text: Two ships. Which one is the ship of Theseus?

new_end.text: You chose the ship that kept sailing. Its parts changed. Its story didn't.

old_end.text: You chose the original wood. Every plank is the same. But is the ship?
